_readme: STRAWMAN — nothing reads this file yet. See DEPLOYMENT.md section 3.
Proposal: this becomes the single source of truth for per-box identity.
apply-system-config.sh would RENDER hostapd/dnsmasq/nftables from it, and the
app would READ it for the captive-portal address, ports and display headers —
so no literal SSID, passphrase or subnet survives in the scripts or the Python.
Copy to setup/site.json (gitignored, per-box). Values below are the current
hardcoded defaults, so this file describes the existing Pi exactly.

audio._note: Supersedes base_station/audio_config.json if adopted. bt_mac is written by the pairing flow, not hand-edited. Do not tune leadSeconds from headphone tests — it is calibrated against the competition speaker.
